what.text: This page follows refugees from Indonesia in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9215 refugees from Indonesia.
Papua New Guinea hosts the largest share, 83.6%, followed by the United States, Australia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over East Timor territory in Indonesia in periods from 1975 to 1999, and over Aceh territory with GAM in 1990 to 1991 and 1999 to 2005.
It also records armed conflict over West Papua territory with the OPM in some years, most recently from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1978 at 1000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 34722, at the end of 2006, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2004 to 2009.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
